items.statement: The Jacobian is not supplied to the trace map; Part A derives only finitely many Jacobian candidates from pure formal fixed traces.
The conclusion is quasi-finiteness only, not injectivity, global uniqueness, or generic degree one.
The source is only the single-factor monic-centered space H^1_4; no degree-four composition or arbitrary loxodromic polynomial automorphism is covered.
Part A is over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, while Parts B and C are only over C; no broader descent is claimed.
Formal-period zero-cycles with scheme-theoretic multiplicities are essential; reduced periodic points cannot replace them.
No novelty is claimed for Cantat--Dujardin's general rigidity, unspecified finite cutoff, exceptional quartic family, or its period-one/two blindness.
No novelty is claimed for residue identities, Sugiyama or Huguin, Morton-type fixed-point identities, formal dynatomic methods, or Friedland--Milnor normal forms.
No novelty is claimed for Paper 12's classification of E, formal subtraction, coefficient ledgers, or period-three moment.
No statement P(d)=3 for all degrees, effective all-degree cutoff, or universal nonvanishing of coefficients D_m is claimed.
No exact fiber cardinality, map degree, generic degree, branch divisor, or global injectivity statement is claimed.
No algorithm, computation, CAS check, scan, experiment, absolute priority, or absence-of-unpublished-work claim is made.
Only the precise normalized slice and its finite residual quotient are covered; no unnormalized or multifactored moduli claim is made.
The second period-three power sum separates only E and E/mu_3; it is not asserted to classify all of H^1_4.

part_A.base_field: Any algebraically closed field k of characteristic zero
part_A.candidate_bound: A prescribed formal fixed trace multiset leaves at most d-1 values of s and hence at most d-1 Jacobians; in degree four at most 3.
part_A.definitions: For d>=2, a in k^*, p monic centered of degree d, s=1-a=1+J(f), q=p-s*x.
part_A.purity: The Jacobian is an output candidate derived from Trace_1, never an input.

part_B.exact_locus: E is exactly the non-quasi-finite locus of T_<=2:H^1_4 -> Sym^4(C) x Sym^12(C).
part_B.exceptional_curve: E={(a,p) in H^1_4: a=1 and p(x)=(x^2-L)^2 for L in C}
part_B.lower_trace_fiber: Trace_1=0 with multiplicity 4 and Trace_2=2 with multiplicity 12.
part_B.quotient: E/mu_3 is A^1 with coordinate L^3.

part_C.cutoff: P_(H^1)(4)=3 for formal pure trace data on the single-factor normalized quartic space.
part_C.exceptional_separator: On E, the pointwise second power sum of Trace_3 is -1296000-1572864*L^3.
part_C.global_statement: T_<=3 is quasi-finite on H^1_4 and descends to a quasi-finite map on M^1_4, while T_<=2 is not quasi-finite on either space.
part_C.separator_scope: Equality of the full Trace_3 multiset implies equality of its second power sum; this moment is used only to separate E.

unified_dependency_order: Pure fixed traces enumerate finitely many Jacobians.
The five a=1 root partitions identify E as the exact lower bad locus.
The formal period-three moment separates the residual coordinate L^3 on E.
Finite geometric fibers and finite type give global quasi-finiteness.
